_about: Phrases in straight quotes that are the guides' own wording, sayings, questions or labels, not quotations from a source. scripts/check-quotes.mjs skips each one for its guide and reports everything else in quotes as a quotation to verify against content/quote-sources.json. Every entry needs a one-line reason; an empty reason fails the check, and so does an entry whose phrase is no longer in its guide.
